# Bid the bays, the eave, and the floor.

> Price a post-frame pole barn from bays, eave height, overhead doors, lean-to, and gravel vs slab — plus the walk-away price a $45-a-foot ag special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
